skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Seeker SKm01
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Seeker Series Swimming Suit SKm01. The material is light, breathable and exquisite. It's been tailored to meet the needs of those inventive elites.
skins.quote: Though the Silverashes will never be afraid of challenges, summertime seaside still feels a bit too hot.

skins.name: York's Bise
skins.content: SilverAsh's Tailor-Made Outfit by Savile/York's Bise. The expensive fabrics are as cold-resistant as possible while still ensuring comfort. Combined with a special scarf to reflect the discerning taste of the tailor.
skins.quote: One glance, and you already know everything you need about Victoria's sacred tome.

skins.name: Never-melting Ice
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Never-melting Ice. One of SilverAsh's suits, tailored for important events. The weight of the name of Silverash clan can tear rifts across Terra. Even majestic glaciers and roiling clouds make way for him.
skins.quote: Enciodes rejected those insignificant, sycophantic invitations to cooperation. He believes Kjerag will eventually conquer the entire audience, but understands that now is not the time for the ice to melt.
